observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 4 console with two black controllers placed on top.
The console has 'SONY' and 'PS4' printed on the front, visible in photo 0.
The controllers appear to be standard DualShock 4 style, with one controller having a custom black and white design on the faceplate.
The console is placed on a marble-patterned surface.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and '2 GAMES' overlaid on the image.
No games, cables, or other accessories are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Ps4 with fc27 and 6 games inside
claims.evidence: No games are visible in photo 0. The claim of 6 games cannot be verified from the photo.
One controller is visible in photo 0; the second is not shown. Its condition is not visible.
No accessories (cables, power brick, etc.) are visible in photo 0.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not be functional or may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, power, cooling).
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: The controllers may be non-functional or have damaged buttons/ports.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs.

risks.risk: The games may be missing, damaged, or not included as claimed.
risks.proof: Photos of all 6 games with their cases and discs, or a video showing them in the console.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the serial number and model label on the console, and a video of the console's system settings showing the model.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Photos of all 6 games with their cases and discs.
Close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label.
Video of the console's system settings showing the model and firmware version.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
